description: Source code for a file merging and diffing library, specifically implementing merge logic including conflict resolution, conflict refinement, and merging strategies for text files.

classes.name: xdmerge_t
classes.description: Structure representing a merge hunk or conflict region, including pointers to neighboring hunks and mode indicating conflict or non-conflict.

methods.name: xdl_append_merge
methods.description: Appends a merge hunk to the list, merging overlapping hunks if necessary.

methods.name: xdl_cleanup_merge
methods.description: Frees all merge hunks and returns the number of conflicts.

methods.name: xdl_merge_cmp_lines
methods.description: Compares lines from two file environments for equality.

methods.name: xdl_recs_copy_0
methods.description: Copies a range of records from a file environment into a buffer, optionally adding newline and carriage return characters.

methods.name: xdl_recs_copy
methods.description: Copies records from a file environment into a buffer.

methods.name: xdl_orig_copy
methods.description: Copies original records from a file environment into a buffer.

methods.name: is_eol_crlf
methods.description: Determines if a line ends with CRLF, LF, or cannot be determined.

methods.name: is_cr_needed
methods.description: Determines if carriage return is needed based on surrounding lines' end-of-line styles.

methods.name: fill_conflict_hunk
methods.description: Generates a conflict hunk with conflict markers and record contents.

methods.name: xdl_fill_merge_buffer
methods.description: Builds the final merged output buffer from merge hunks.

methods.name: recmatch
methods.description: Checks if two records match based on flags.

methods.name: xdl_refine_zdiff3_conflicts
methods.description: Refines conflicts by removing common lines from conflict regions.

methods.name: xdl_refine_conflicts
methods.description: Refines conflicts by diffing and minimizing conflict regions.

methods.name: line_contains_alnum
methods.description: Checks if a line contains any alphanumeric character.

methods.name: lines_contain_alnum
methods.description: Checks if any line in a range contains alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: xdl_merge_two_conflicts
methods.description: Merges two adjacent conflict hunks into one.

methods.name: xdl_simplify_non_conflicts
methods.description: Simplifies non-conflicting regions by merging small non-conflicting hunks.

methods.name: xdl_do_merge
methods.description: Performs the core merge operation, handling conflicts and non-conflicting regions based on merge level and style.

methods.name: xdl_merge
methods.description: High-level function to perform a three-way merge of files, returning the merged result.
